messages:
maria: OK team, kicking off jp1 (asia-northeast-1) region bring-up thread. Target: GitOps/Helm pipeline + signed image replication + GPU node pool provisioning. Need quick owners and a short preflight checklist.

miguel: I can own the registry replication and signing checks. plan: deploy our replicator to the staging registry first, validate cosign signatures, then enable push-through to jp1 mirror.

priya: I'll take CNI/NAT and networking (egress IPs, cloud NAT sizing). reminder: some APAC subnets need larger ephemeral port limits for heavy batching.

zhen: I'll handle GPU node pool provisioning and taints/tolerations for inference. We'll create a 3-node initial pool with A100-equivalent and taints: inference=true:NoSchedule.

maria: high-level preflight I want covered: kubeconfig bootstrap via GitOps seed repo, helm values for gpu nodeSelector/taints, registry mirror + cosign verification, service egress NAT, VPC peering to logging stack, and cost estimate for 30-day smoke.

jamie: suggestion: add an image residency check to the pipeline that fails if an image isn't mirrored in jp1. small script idea:
```bash
# check image exists in mirror
reg=mirror.jp1.redwood-internal
img=my-app:sha256-abc123
curl -f https://$reg/v2/my-app/manifests/$img || exit 1
```
This helps avoid cross-region pulls during canary.

miguel: replicator config snippet (staging->jp1):
```yaml
replicator: 
  source: eu-west2.registry.redwood
  targets:
    - mirror.jp1.redwood-internal
  filters:
    - tag: ".*"
  verify_cosign: true
```
We'll also require cosign signatures before target sync; replicator will skip unsigned images.

deploy-bot: registry-mirror deployment successful in staging at 2026-02-10T09:12:04Z :white_check_mark:

priya: networking gotcha: cloud NAT needs at least 20000 ephemeral ports for heavy tokenization workloads. If you expect >500 concurrent inference workers per node pool, bump NAT. Also open TCP 2379/2380 for etcd endpoints only from control plane.

zhen: GPU provisioning checklist (short):
- create node pool jp1-gpu-1 (3 nodes)
- taint: inference=true:NoSchedule
- daemonset: nvidia-driver-installer
- test job: run small gpu inference container and assert nvml visible devices

maria: CI gating rules for GitOps PR to cluster-configs/jp1:
- manifest lint (kubeval)
- helm template render success
- image residency check passes
- smoke e2e (single pod inference) must pass in staging cluster
- cost estimate artifact attached (see cost calc template)

jamie: cost calc quick numbers for initial proof-of-life:
- 3 x A100-equivalent nodes 24/7 ~= $9k/mo (on-demand estimate)
- ephemeral test load 2000 GPU-hours spread across 30 days adds ~ $6k for burst testing
- registry egress/storage negligible (<$200) if we mirror selectively
We'll refine with committed reserved pricing if Dedicated needed.

miguel: security note: replicate only signed manifests; use cosign public key stored in KMS. command we use in pipeline: 
```bash
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/replica-key $IMAGE
```
Fail the pipeline if verification fails.

priya: also add route table check: ensure logging/monitoring VPCs are reachable via peering. We had an earlier outage when metric exports couldn't reach the collector due to missing route. quick command: 
```bash
# verify VPC peering routes
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VPC_ID
```

zhen: after the staging smoke passes, plan a small canary rollout: 5% of traffic -> jp1 via smart routing policy for 24h, monitor latency/cost and KV cache hit rates. rollback to eu-west2 if errors >1% or 99p latency regresses by >50ms.

maria: handoff doc required for oncall: include runbook for (1) registry mismatch, (2) cosign failures, (3) node pool OOM/unsched, (4) NAT exhaustion. assign pager to oncall rotation and attach runbook link to the cluster-configs PR.

jamie: I'll write the handoff template. quick stub: 
- Incident: registry replication fails -> triage: check replicator logs, cosign status, last synced manifest.
- Escalation: ping @miguel -> if replication backlog >5m items, promote emergency replication window.

miguel: one more operational note: enable manifest GC on mirror after 30 days unless pinned by prod tag to save storage. retention policy: keep latest 3 tags per repo.

maria: thanks. action items summary:
- miguel: deploy replicator to jp1 staging, cosign config, retention policy (ETA: 48h)
- priya: provision cloud NAT + route tables + peering checks (ETA: 24h)
- zhen: create gpu node pool + daemonsets + e2e smoke job (ETA: 24-48h)
- jamie: handoff runbook and CI gating PR (ETA: 24h)

maria: we'll reconvene here after staging smoke. ping this thread with PR links. :rocket:
